wars.name: Russia–Ukraine war
wars.background: Russia annexed Crimea and backed separatists in the Donbas in 2014, then launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. After Ukraine pushed Russian forces back from Kyiv, Kharkiv and Kherson in 2022, the front settled into attritional fighting in the east and south, with long-range drone and missile strikes on cities and energy infrastructure on both sides.

wars.name: Iran: war with Israel and the US, and state repression
wars.background: Iran and Israel fought a long proxy conflict through allied groups in Lebanon, Syria, Iraq and Yemen. In 2024 they exchanged direct missile strikes, and in June 2025 Israel and the United States struck Iranian nuclear and military sites in a twelve-day war. UCDP also records lethal violence by the Iranian government against civilians, including protesters.
